reuse.why: Extends the existing shared getDateWithSkippedWeekend and the RSchedule exdates mechanism rather than adding a parallel date path.

duplication.why: The moving rule is defined once in getDateWithSkippedWeekend and the daily skip once in getHolidayExdates, but the exdates wiring has to be repeated at each RSchedule construction.

placement.why: Both helpers live in shared/schedules.ts next to the weekend logic, but the holiday exclusion is attached at each RSchedule call site (rule-utils, two in schedules/app.ts) instead of in the recurConfigToRSchedule layer that already turns daily skipWeekend into a rule, and find-schedules' construction is left without it.

scope.why: Only the weekend/holiday paths, the RecurConfig type, tests and a release note are touched.

maintainability.why: Generalising the solve to a step loop over an off-day predicate is clean, though daily skipping is split between the rrule (weekends) and exdates (holidays), getHolidayExdates takes an untyped config, and any new RSchedule construction must remember to add exdates.

one_place.where: getDateWithSkippedWeekend (move) and getHolidayExdates (daily skip) in packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts, used by getNextDate/parseRecurDate, getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange and schedule-template; find-schedules' takeDates RSchedule is not wired
